basic_details.job_title: KEA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 38 Sericulture Inspector, Marketing Overseer Posts
basic_details.short_information: Karnataka Examinations Authority, Bengaluru (KEA) has invited applications for 38 posts in 2 roles under Advt No. ED/KEA/31/NE.VI/2026(KK). The posts include Sericulture Inspector, Marketing Overseer. Applications are accepted online until 15 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online. Last date to pay the fee: 16 December 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Sericulture Inspector: degree in Sericulture, or a science degree with a PG diploma in Sericulture; if no such candidates are available, a science degree with Botany, Zoology or Sericulture as a subject, or a degree in Agriculture or Horticulture. Marketing Overseer: B.Sc. in Agricultural Marketing and Co-operation, or B.Sc. (Hons) Agricultural Marketing and Co-operation, or B.Sc. (Hons) Agricultural Business Management from an ICAR-recognised Agricultural University.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Degree in Sericulture, or a degree in science with post graduate diploma in sericulture. If no suitable candidates are available, a degree in science with Botany or Zoology or Sericulture as one of the subjects, or a degree in Agriculture or Horticulture. Age limit: Minimum 18 years. Pay: 44425-1125-47800-1250-52800-1375-58300-1500-64300-1650-74200-1900-83700. Qualification required: B.Sc. in Agricultural Marketing and Co-operation; B.Sc. (Hons) Agricultural Marketing and Co-operation; B.Sc. (Hons) Agricultural Business Management from an ICAR-recognised Agricultural University. Age limit: Minimum 18 years. Pay: 44425-83700.

exam_pattern.details: Negative marking of 0.25 for each wrong answer

how_to_apply: Apply online through the KEA website https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/.
Upload a recent photograph in JPEG format with white background, 50KB to 200KB.
Upload signature in JPEG format, 50KB to 70KB.
important_instructions: Candidates are advised to check the website regularly for updates
